description: This file defines the RequestWorkItem class, which is a specialized work item used within the Orleans runtime scheduler to handle requests. It includes properties and methods for managing request execution and formatting.

classes.name: RequestWorkItem
classes.description: A sealed class representing a work item for processing a request within the Orleans scheduler, encapsulating request details and execution logic.

methods.name: RequestWorkItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing the work item with a target and a message request.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Property returning a string identifier for the work item, including the request ID.

methods.name: GrainContext
methods.description: Property returning the grain context associated with the target.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Method to execute the work item, invoking the target to handle the new request.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Method to format the work item as a string, including request details, into a provided span.
